messages:
Sam W: Quick sync — we need final alignment on enterprise security roadmap for audit/logging, BYOK, SOC2/ISO and retention. Who's available?

Anya P: On it. Can we list minimal launch gates?

Omar K: My take:
1) Immutable audit log at ingestion
2) Retention policy config + export
3) BYOK for Dedicated/Private
4) SOC2/ISO evidence pack

Lucy Z: Agree. Also: log schema and mapping to controls (change-management, access events) need to be stable before GA.

Anya P: For retention, propose three buckets: 90d default, 1y compliance tier, 7y archival export.

Sam W: Sounds good. What about cost? storage + egress for exports.

Omar K: We should offer sampling vs full capture. Some enterprise customers insist on full capture though.

Lucy Z: BYOK scope: support AWS KMS first, then GCP KMS, then HSM integrations. BYOK alpha: Dedicated only (Q3).

Sam W: Can we ship audit logs + retention config in Q2 beta without BYOK? Customer asks suggest yes.

Anya P: Launch gates (draft):
- Gate 1: audit ingest + stable schema
- Gate 2: retention + export tooling (CSV + API)
- Gate 3: BYOK alpha (Dedicated) — optional for GA
- Gate 4: SOC2/ISO evidence pack & controls mapping

Omar K: Infra dependency: append-only storage (S3 object lock or equivalent). Eng-infra to own.

Lucy Z: Security will own SOC2 control mapping. I'll pair with Anya to produce the mapping doc.

Sam W: @security-bot can you attach current SOC2 checklist link?

security-bot: Posted: https://redwood-internal/soc2/controls-v1

Anya P: We should define acceptance criteria per gate. Example for retention: users can set retention_days, export job exists, exported data has tamper-evidence metadata.

Omar K: Example retention config:
```
audit:
  enabled: true
  retention_days: 365
  export:
    enabled: true
    schedule: daily
    destination: s3://customer-bucket
```

Sam W: Nice. Add KMS key_id field in BYOK config and a quick onboarding checklist.

Anya P: Tradeoffs: BYOK increases support surface + onboarding time. Limit to Dedicated Beta to reduce blast radius.

Lucy Z: ISO27001 also requires documented key handling and proof of encryption; include that in Gate 4.

Omar K: Sales asks: CSV export + API to pull logs programmatically. Add API endpoint to MVP scope.

Sam W: Priorities/timeline: Audit ingest + API + retention config -> Q2-beta. BYOK Dedicated alpha -> Q3. SOC2 evidence & GA -> Q4.

Anya P: I'll update the roadmap doc & create JIRA epics. Ping me with blockers.

Lucy Z: :thumbsup: I'll start a control-mapping PR and link it.

Omar K: I'll sync with eng-infra re: append-only storage, perf impact, and cost estimates.

Sam W: Thanks all. Reconvene next week. Owners: @Anya P create epics, @Omar K scope infra, @Lucy Z draft SOC2 mapping.
